verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an agent platform with a CLI and SDK, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out setting. Open-source self-hosting under Apache 2.0 is a different capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
